verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Cursor supports a simple browser-based sign-in flow (cursor-docs-49) and that using Cursor's own hosted models by default does not require managing personal API keys (cursor-supp-byo-api-keys implies keys are optional, only needed for bringing your own models). However, the pack contains no direct mention of a free tier, pricing plan, or usage quota tied to signing in with a personal account. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a free/Hobby tier, sign-up flow for personal accounts, and any quota/limit details tied to that tier.
